name: Chijoku Kakeizu
source:
Main character has to flee from his house and find a modest room nearby. However, feels jealous of a warm relations family that moved into his house, so he decides to break that family. However, he gets so exhausted from starving that he is found unconscious by that family members. Only women live in this house, and he takes this chance to spread his poison.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角必须逃离他的房子并在附近找到一间简陋的房间。然而，他嫉妒搬进他家的一个温馨的关系家庭，所以他决定打破这个家庭。然而，他因饥饿而精疲力竭，被家人发现昏迷不醒。这所房子里只有女人住，他趁此机会散播毒药。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
